description: Personal profile and working axioms for a non-standard mathematics system: alternative symbols, arithmetic, logic, calculus, geometry, and applied security/steganography uses.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Arithmetic Operations
axioms.summary: Defines addition, subtraction, multiplication and division rules in the non-standard representation, including carry/borrow and conversion to base-10 for interoperability.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Algebraic Equations
axioms.summary: Solving and simplifying equations using non-standard variables and representation-aware transforms.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Calculus
axioms.summary: Derivatives, integrals and limits defined over non-standard representations; study behavior of non-standard functions.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Geometry
axioms.summary: Shapes, transformations and measurements expressed and reasoned about in the non-standard numeric system.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Number Theory
axioms.summary: Primality, divisibility and modular-style properties adapted to your representations.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Mathematical Logic
axioms.summary: Logical operators, truth values and proof techniques expressed using the system's symbolic operators (examples: O, !).

axioms.title: Non-Standard Statistical Analysis
axioms.summary: Statistical measures and hypothesis testing applied to data encoded under the non-standard system.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Mathematical Modeling
axioms.summary: Build models and simulations that operate in the non-standard domain for applied physics, imaging, or encryption experiments.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Logic Operators
axioms.summary: Defines semantics for symbolic logic operators (NOT, AND, OR, implication) mapped to the system's symbols.

axioms.title: Non-Standard Logic Operations
axioms.summary: Propositional and predicate logic rules adapted to the non-standard framework; inference and equivalence rules.

axioms.title: Number Theory and Logic Interaction
axioms.summary: Explores how quantifiers and logical formulations interact with number-theoretic statements in the non-standard system.

notes: This file is a living profile. I can expand any axiom into formal definitions, examples, conversion rules, or test vectors. Tell me which axiom to formalize first.
